canonical_payload.reason: Owner roster decision 2026-11-28 (handoff HISTORICAL-LISTINGS-ROSTER-20261127): single listing 002013 中航机电 was terminated by SZSE effective 2023-03-17 (announcement of 2023-03-15, https://www.szse.cn/disclosure/notice/t20230315_599254.html, SZSE listing rules 9.7.1/9.7.9) through the share-swap absorption of 中航工业机电系统股份有限公司 by 中航航空电子系统股份有限公司 600372 (CSRC approval 证监许可〔2022〕3241号); the legal personality of 002013 was deregistered and the surviving 600372 renamed to 中航机载系统股份有限公司 (中航机载) in 2023-08 (company announcement 2023-055). Provable succession sits with the successor issuer outside this roster: 002013 → absorbed by 600372 中航电子 → renamed 中航机载; the in-universe 300114 中航电测 (ENT_1b336470) is a different listed company and is NOT the successor.
